facts.raised-sword: A young page stands holding a sword raised at a slant with both hands.
facts.looking-back: The page turns the head and looks over the shoulder.
facts.rough-hill: The page stands on a bumpy hill, with puffy clouds rising around.
facts.birds: A flock of birds flies in the sky at the upper left.
facts.wind-trees: Trees at the lower left are bent by the wind.
facts.clothes: The page wears a pinkish top with yellow sleeves and red boots, and the hair is blown by the wind.

glosses.birds: Scattering thoughts; information moving quickly back and forth.
glosses.raised-sword: Testing words and thoughts still being learned.

reversedGloss.excess: Wariness and talk go too far, becoming sharp and hasty.
reversedGloss.blocked: There is something to look into, but the page stands still without preparing.

misdescriptions.wrong: He rests with the sword planted in the ground.
